extraction.Name: Sophia Munroe
extraction.Refused/Protested: refused to accept her patent in fee for a long time, but finally accepted it on the advise of Superintendent Tidwell, who told her that if she did not take it and pay the taxes that she would lose the land anyway
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Ipswich Bank, Ipswich, So. Dak. for $500.00; sold the land to Mrs. Voltz of Martin, So. Dak. for $300.00 in trade at a store, and she was to pay the mortgage
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: could not pay the taxes so she had to mortgage it to Ipswich Bank, Ipswich, So. Dak. for $500.00, that she could not pay the mortgage, interest or taxes so she sold the land to Mrs. Voltz of Martin, So. Dak. for $300.00 in trade at a store
extraction.Occupation/Income: supported by her husband who raises a garden and does what common labor he can, but that they only make about $150.00 per year
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent but in very poor health; owns 40 acres of land on which she lives with her husband; has no one depending on her; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since she was granted a patent; document dated December 5, 1828 (likely a transcription error for a later date); County of Shannon, State of South Dakota | TASK 3 BULK TRIBE INFERENCE 2026-04-29: Tribe field set to 'Pine Ridge' based on directory provenance (record is filed in pine_ridge_*/extractions/, which corresponds to the NARA RG 75 Pine Ridge Vol 1, Vol 2, and Vol 3 bound volumes of Circular 2464 responses). 67 such records were originally 'not stated'; 6 received BLM-confirmed substantive patches in the same transaction; the remaining 61 (this record's batch) are inferred from directory and geographic/naming evidence. Inference is rebuttable — any record can be re-evaluated via BLM cross-reference if its Pine Ridge affiliation is questioned.
